message.content:
**Overall Impression:** The interface is clean and well-structured, but suffers from a critical layout misalignment in the stats bar and minor inconsistencies in the card list.

### Visual QA Report

| # | Location | Issue | Severity |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | **Top Stats Bar (الإحصائيات)** | **Critical Misalignment:** The first stat box ("1 مشروع نشط") is significantly taller than the other three boxes, breaking the horizontal grid line. | **P1** |
| 2 | **Top Stats Bar** | **Inconsistent Backgrounds:** The first stat box has a beige/cream background, while the other three are white/transparent. This creates visual imbalance. | **P2** |
| 3 | **Project Cards List** | **Inconsistent Tag Colors:** The status tags ("نشط" vs "مُعلّق") use different background colors (Green vs Yellow), which is likely intentional, but the text contrast on the yellow tag appears slightly lower than the green one. | **P3** |
| 4 | **Sidebar (Right)** | **Icon Alignment:** The icons in the navigation menu (e.g., "الرئيسية", "المشاريع") appear slightly off-center vertically relative to their text labels in some items. | **P3** |
| 5 | **Header Search Bar** | **Placeholder Alignment:** The search icon inside the main header search bar is not perfectly centered vertically with the placeholder text. | **P3** |
